coverage.reason: The feature backfill issues own the current shipped-feature inventory and must switch this registry to complete mode after their entries land.

features.title: Expansion locale selection and pseudo-locale routing
Versioned locale preference persistence and repair
Localized text consumers, input, and static UI graphics
Localization profile validation and resource budgets

cases.title: Tester-case catalog foundation
profiles: Clean source checkout with Python 3; no ROM, emulator, artifact, or optional feature profile
cases.purpose: Exercise the stable catalog schema and checker integration that future feature cases extend.
cases.prerequisites: Start from the repository root with docs/test-cases and scripts/check_docs.py present; no save state is needed.
cases.actions: Inspect the catalog index, template, and registry; run the focused docs-checker unit test and the checker command named below.
cases.expected_result: The registry exposes separate feature and case records, the procedure is indexed, and both commands accept the valid foundation data.
cases.negative_control: Focused fixtures reject malformed or duplicate IDs, unknown ownership, missing links or anchors, placeholders, unnamed automation, missing exclusion rationale, and a missing complete-mode feature.
cases.interactions: Depends on issue #53's tester-case contract. The feature backfill is deliberately deferred to issues #55 through #58.
cases.save_compatibility: No save bytes, migration, compatibility epoch, or runtime profile changes.
cases.limitations: This foundation validates the schema and extension seam only; it does not yet assert full current-feature coverage.

cases.title: Mechanics registry applies ordered, bounded hooks
profiles: Modern AAPCS release starter profile with mechanics hooks and sample enabled
Modern AAPCS default profile with mechanics hooks disabled
cases.purpose: Verify deterministic registry order, bounded registration failures, the real battle seam, and disabled inertness.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with a host C compiler; libmGBA is required only by the mapped ROM gate.
cases.actions: Run the mechanics host suite, the release starter hook gate, and the sample-without-hooks dependency failure.
cases.expected_result: The registry is ordered, accepts eight entries, refuses the ninth, the enabled real bout reports the documented counters and +1 defence delta, and invalid dependencies fail before compilation.
cases.negative_control: The flags-off host and ROM paths leave all hook state inert and preserve the same resolved vanilla battle.
cases.interactions: The sample and starter content require hooks; danger, casual, and AoE are independent.
cases.save_compatibility: Diagnostic fingerprint only; no save field, layout, migration, or compatibility-epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast only to remove artifacts.
cases.limitations: The registry is a battle-stat seam, not a content catalog, option menu, or persisted setting.

cases.title: Full-HP Guard grants exactly one bounded defence
profiles: Modern AAPCS release starter profile with mechanics hooks and sample enabled
Modern AAPCS default profile with mechanics hooks and sample disabled
cases.purpose: Prove the sample's full-HP condition, exact delta, cap, and real-combat seam.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root; the mapped clean-boot route needs libmGBA.
cases.actions: Run the sample host test, the release starter hook gate, and the disabled host test.
cases.expected_result: Full HP adds exactly +1 defence, damaged subjects add zero, and the 99-defence cap bounds the result.
cases.negative_control: A disabled sample is absent, inert, and cannot be enabled without its required registry.
cases.interactions: Starter content adds a separate +5 avoid callback through the same registry without changing defence behavior.
cases.save_compatibility: No save state, layout, migration, or compatibility-epoch impact.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast only to remove artifacts.
cases.limitations: The content-free sample has no player-facing toggle and is not a downstream ruleset.

cases.title: Threat Range menu toggles and safely returns to the map
profiles: Modern AAPCS debug or release starter QoL profile with danger overlay enabled
Matching modern AAPCS default profile with danger overlay disabled
cases.purpose: Verify the player-reachable overlay lifecycle and its default-disabled absence.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with libmGBA; the scenario starts clean and creates no save fixture.
cases.actions: Run the host table tests and the debug QoL gate; select Threat Range and cancel twice on the enabled Prologue map.
cases.expected_result: The menu adds one entry, displays exactly 39 danger tiles, cancels twice, and returns to an interactive map.
cases.negative_control: The default menu is vanilla and its semantic overlay probe remains all-zero on the same route.
cases.interactions: Independent of mechanics, content, casual mode, and AoE; reuses the vanilla danger-zone path.
cases.save_compatibility: No saved option bit, save field, layout, migration, or compatibility-epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Exit with B; use make clean_fast only to remove artifacts.
cases.limitations: Semantic probe values automate range behavior; no extra threat UI or AI behavior is included.

cases.title: Starter Sample Charm composes generated data and hooks
profiles: Modern AAPCS debug content profile with item cap 0xCE, starter content, hooks, and sample enabled
Modern AAPCS starter profile with content disabled and vanilla item cap
cases.purpose: Verify the authored item record, production name/UI path, serialization round trips, item-gated effect, and dependencies.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root; generated content is build-local and the runtime gate needs libmGBA.
cases.actions: Run the item expansion gate, the starter content host suite, and both invalid dependency profiles.
cases.expected_result: Sample Charm has halfword 0x03CE, three uses, icon 222, authored name, and exactly +5 avoid for its bearer only.
cases.negative_control: Content-disabled builds omit the callback, accessor, authored bytes, and expanded table; missing hooks or cap fail explicitly.
cases.interactions: Requires mechanics hooks and item cap 0xCE; sample is optional and all other optional gameplay modules are independent.
cases.save_compatibility: Existing item and game/suspend serialization only; no save layout, migration, or compatibility-epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast to remove generated profile artifacts.
cases.limitations: Only the name is shown in game; help text is intentionally unset and this is one example, not a content pack.

cases.title: Casual defeat restores ordinary player defeats only
profiles: Modern AAPCS profile with casual mode enabled
Modern AAPCS default profile with casual mode disabled
cases.purpose: Execute ordinary-defeat marking/restoration and prove permanent-removal exclusions and cross-profile serialization.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with a host C compiler; no campaign-specific death event or save fixture is required.
cases.actions: Run the casual host driver, the issue 34 contract suite, and enabled, disabled, and invalid config resolutions.
cases.expected_result: Enabled combat and arena defeats mark and restore at a chapter boundary; direct scripted and hazard paths remain permanent.
cases.negative_control: Disabled mode preserves ordinary permadeath and existing serialized marker state without activating restoration.
cases.interactions: Independent of starter, danger, and AoE modules; alternate restoration policies do not stack.
cases.save_compatibility: Uses existing packed unit and suspend state; no field, layout, migration, or compatibility-epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Use make distclean only if this case created Autoconf output.
cases.limitations: The framework ships no campaign-specific scripted-death chapter; the real policy host driver is the deterministic tester surface.

cases.title: Typed AoE reference heals bounded allied targets
profiles: Modern AAPCS debug or release isolated AoE reference profile
Matching forced disabled AoE reference profile
cases.purpose: Verify typed targeting, the bounded reference effect, state restoration, and disabled symbol omission.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root; libmGBA is needed by the mapped live gate.
cases.actions: Run the AoE host suite and the debug and release AoE gates.
cases.expected_result: A radius-2 ally heal applies exactly three HP in deterministic order, rejects over-capacity sets, and restores temporary probe state.
cases.negative_control: The disabled profile omits the probe and callback and leaves the public reference API inert.
cases.interactions: Independent of starter and casual flags and intentionally separate from the battle-stat registry.
cases.save_compatibility: Atomic rebuild stores no transient target, callback, pointer, or proc state and changes no save layout or epoch.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast to remove the isolated enabled and disabled build roots.
cases.limitations: The reference is not a spell/item pack; downstream projects own item routes and UI.

cases.title: Optional gameplay profiles compose without changing saves
profiles: Modern AAPCS debug combined profile with all issue 55 optional gameplay flags enabled
Modern AAPCS default profile with all optional gameplay flags disabled
cases.purpose: Verify the documented dependencies, independent optional modules, and save-neutral combined configuration.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with a clean or command-line-only configuration.
cases.actions: Resolve the full combined profile, run configuration contracts, then run the starter and AoE member gates.
cases.expected_result: The full profile resolves, content and sample coexist, and each independent module retains its positive behavior.
cases.negative_control: The all-default profile is off and invalid dependencies or non-binary values fail before compilation.
cases.interactions: Sample requires hooks; content requires hooks and cap 0xCE; danger, casual, and AoE are otherwise independent with no conflicts.
cases.save_compatibility: All flags alter diagnostic fingerprint only and preserve ExpansionSaveMeta, packed-unit layout, and compatibility epoch.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast for artifacts and make distclean only for generated Autoconf output.
cases.limitations: This is not an all-feature artifact and does not enable complete catalog coverage mode.

cases.title: Default English and single-locale auto-select
profiles: Modern AAPCS debug and release default English-only 16 MiB profile
cases.purpose: Prove the supported default remains selector-free and does not create a redundant settings route.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with libmGBA; use the target-generated blank and UNSET SRAM fixtures.
cases.actions: Run the default debug and release localization runtime gates, then attempt Right on the one-locale Configuration row.
cases.expected_result: English is the only enabled locale, no selector is visible, and the single-locale settings action is a no-op.
cases.negative_control: No real locale payload is selected or linked, and multi-locale UI does not appear on blank default SRAM.
cases.interactions: Independent of optional feature flags and relies only on the existing locale preference record.
cases.save_compatibility: No layout, migration, compatibility epoch, or default-locale change.
cases.cleanup: Remove ignored build output with make clean_fast or regenerate fixture SRAM before rerunning.
cases.limitations: This proves selection semantics, not translation quality.

cases.title: Selector, inline configuration, More, and pseudo locale
profiles: Modern AAPCS en,qps-ploc 16 MiB debug and release profile
Modern AAPCS CJK and European 32 MiB named profiles
cases.purpose: Prove first-start selection, inline Configuration changes, bounded More routing, and pseudo-locale labelling.
cases.prerequisites: Start from blank SRAM or the generated valid English preference fixture.
cases.actions: Run the multi-locale runtime gates, choose Pseudo (Test), navigate the Language row, and use inline, More, and Back actions.
cases.expected_result: Only real selections change stable locale IDs, cache generation, and stored preferences; Back does not change state.
cases.negative_control: Single-locale Configuration has no More route, and qps-ploc is never claimed as a production translation.
cases.interactions: Expansion and full-game caches invalidate together after a real switch; no optional feature conflicts exist.
cases.save_compatibility: Uses the existing preference subrecord without a layout or migration change.
cases.cleanup: Regenerate the named fixture or use clean SRAM for a different first-start choice.
cases.limitations: The test route verifies behavior and labels, not translation editorial quality.

cases.title: Production expansion and full-game locale catalogs
profiles: Modern AAPCS CJK, European, and all-locale 32 MiB named profiles
cases.purpose: Prove every production locale has a complete expansion and full-game catalog in its supported profile.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with host compiler and libmGBA; start selector captures with blank SRAM.
cases.actions: Run full-game catalog checks and CJK/European runtime gates, then select each supported locale in its named profile.
cases.expected_result: JA, ZH, and FR selectors commit their stable IDs and every production locale reports complete 3,414-entry full-game coverage.
cases.negative_control: English-only 16 MiB profiles contain no real-locale game payload and disabled locales remain unavailable.
cases.interactions: The expansion and full-game catalogs are distinct inputs driven by one selected profile.
cases.save_compatibility: Locale selection reuses current preferences without changing identifiers, save structure, or epoch.
cases.cleanup: Use separate blank SRAM images for manual selections and clean ignored outputs if necessary.
cases.limitations: Catalog coverage is functional evidence, not a linguistic review.

cases.title: Preference repair, no-wipe behavior, and soft-reset persistence
profiles: Modern AAPCS default and en,qps-ploc debug and release profiles with generated preference fixtures
cases.purpose: Prove every invalid preference state repairs through a real selector without wiping unrelated SRAM.
cases.prerequisites: Use only target-generated UNSET, CORRUPT, UNKNOWN_LOCALE, and DISABLED_LOCALE fixtures.
cases.actions: Run native preference tests and multi-locale debug/release repair gates, select English after a cursor round trip, then soft reset.
cases.expected_result: Repair stores a valid explicit English record, preserves the allowed whole-SRAM hash, and suppresses the selector after reset.
cases.negative_control: A valid explicit preference suppresses prompts, while single-locale repair remains an honestly separate auto-select control.
cases.interactions: Normal save/load and suspend/resume retain their existing regression gates.
cases.save_compatibility: Only the existing 12-byte preference subrecord may change; no format, layout, or epoch migration occurs.
cases.cleanup: Fixture output is ignored and removable through make clean_fast; never commit save data.
cases.limitations: The documented no-wipe exclusions cover existing vanilla bookkeeping and the preference record only.

cases.title: UTF-8 controls, bounded consumers, and cache switching
profiles: Modern AAPCS CJK 32 MiB profile
English-only and archival negative paths
cases.purpose: Execute real UTF-8 consumers, bounded error paths, and cross-catalog cache invalidation.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with host compiler and repository preprocessor available or buildable.
cases.actions: Run renderer, consumer, and resolver-native tests, then perform a documented real locale switch.
cases.expected_result: Valid controls and substitutions remain bounded, malformed input has a visible marker, and both cache families invalidate on switch.
cases.negative_control: English-only and archival retain established legacy paths, and an unbounded modern request fails visibly.
cases.interactions: Scratch/cache state is transient and is independent of saved preferences after the selection is applied.
cases.save_compatibility: No text buffer, control stream, or pointer is persisted and no save contract changes.
cases.cleanup: Host test scratch output is removed by the tests.
cases.limitations: The checks prove rendering mechanics, not translation quality.

cases.title: Locale-specific tactician entry remains byte-bounded
profiles: Modern AAPCS JA or ZH 32 MiB profile with the ASCII entry page
cases.purpose: Verify locale grids and atomic UTF-8-aware tactician-name bounds.
cases.prerequisites: Begin with a known player name and no saved test fixture.
cases.actions: Run mapped native tests, enter a valid bounded name, then try oversize and split-scalar input.
cases.expected_result: Locale pages and ASCII remain available, valid names fit ten encoded bytes plus NUL, and invalid input preserves the prior value.
cases.negative_control: English, pseudo, and archival retain their existing grids and never receive a widened persistent field.
cases.interactions: Uses the selected locale but no optional feature module.
cases.save_compatibility: Uses the existing player-name field and serializers without migration or epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Restore or erase only the test player name.
cases.limitations: No campaign-specific tactician test chapter is supplied.

cases.title: Localized static graphics and CJK menu regressions
profiles: Modern AAPCS CJK and all-locale 32 MiB profiles
cases.purpose: Verify locale-bound static graphics selection and the corrected CJK menu layout contracts.
cases.prerequisites: Blank SRAM, libmGBA, and no save slot before Mode Select.
cases.actions: Run localized UI checks and CJK runtime scenarios, then reach Mode Select and Save Menu after selecting JA or ZH.
cases.expected_result: Registered CJK resources and the corrected zh-Hans OAM layout are selected while semantic locale and persistence probes remain stable.
cases.negative_control: English and European retain FE8U resources, and the former zh-Hans OAM hash remains a rejected regression value.
cases.interactions: Resource selection follows active locale only and conflicts with no optional module.
cases.save_compatibility: Static resource selection does not change saved preferences, layout, or configuration identity.
cases.cleanup: Remove only test SRAM or ignored build output before repeating.
cases.limitations: Visual comparison to authorized regional artwork remains a named manual criterion; semantic selection and layout are automated.

cases.title: Validated localization profiles and resource budgets
profiles: Clean modern AAPCS default, pseudo, CJK, European, and all-locale named profiles
cases.purpose: Validate deterministic catalog generation, isolated profile roots, resource headroom, and invalid profile rejection.
cases.prerequisites: Repository root with ARM toolchain, host compiler, and libmGBA for linked runtime targets.
cases.actions: Run localization and full-game validation, generation, check, and test targets, then run headroom and all-locale release targets plus invalid configuration probes.
cases.expected_result: Valid profiles remain isolated and retain positive map/ELF headroom; invalid size/default/pseudo combinations fail before compilation.
cases.negative_control: No generated output, budget threshold, identity fingerprint, or baseline is refreshed, and invalid profiles do not build.
cases.interactions: Profile metadata is descriptive and shares the stable locale ID ordering across individual and combined profiles.
cases.save_compatibility: Profile identity is not a save-compatibility key and no save contract changes.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast only for ignored artifacts; never hand-edit generated output.
cases.limitations: The restricted-ROM final provenance gate is separate from this shipped source-build procedure.
